scope: Focused read-only closure review of CAT-R3-01 and CAT-R3-02.

closed.conclusion: All supervisor startups acquire the same persistent verified bootstrap OS lock before catalog initialization or validation. The first complete provisioning frame and file/parent Sync occur under that exclusion. A concurrent startup cannot inspect the intermediate empty catalog. The bootstrap lock is explicitly distinct from a case artifact.

Every startup re-Syncs the verified catalog and parent before any case authorization. A surviving complete frame after initial parent Sync failure therefore permits provisioning recovery only after a new successful durability barrier; failure stays globally closed.

lock_and_recovery_checks: Bootstrap may acquire the catalog lock but is released before any case lock. Ordinary operations never acquire bootstrap; existing case-to-catalog order is unchanged, so the specified lock graph has no cycle.
Concurrent provisioning recovery must converge on the same atomically created stable case lock before fixed-member inspection, then follow the existing catalog recheck protocol.
Provisioning recovery never invokes Start, Planner or Registry. Complete verified durable initial members may become ready; otherwise quarantine precedes cleanup.
Absent catalog with case artifacts, or an empty/partial/invalid catalog, remains an integrity failure. The permanent bootstrap lock alone does not prevent legitimate first initialization.
implementation_acceptance_still_required: Named-barrier child-process test after CREATE_NEW and before the first frame: second startup waits; release observes provisioning; creator death preserves the empty/partial failure oracle.
Initial parent Sync failure followed by recovery Sync failure must create zero case locks/directories/members; successful recovery must remain provisioning-only.
OS lock identity, ACL, parent Sync and process-death release must be validated on each supported platform; this review does not execute them.
execution: No tests, builds, services, source edits or design edits. Review reports only.
